note: Fishing (Items refill 12, Tyler's model). No fish entities: a cast is a server roll. Click with the rod at water within reach_m; after a wait (wait_s) something may bite for window_s seconds and a second click lands it. chance = base x fishing skill x time of day x weather x bait x stock; all through fate() so luck applies. Each 'cell' (cell_m square) of water holds a hidden stock that a catch uses up and that comes back one fish per regrow_s (a game day is 3600 real seconds), so a camper cannot empty a pond. The water type of a cell (stream, pond or lake, by its position) picks the species. Raw fish is raw_sick and spoils quickly. Not built: ice holes (frozen water gives no catch yet), spear fishing, bait items beyond the list, fish drawn in the water.
say_nothing: Nothing bites. Try again, or somewhere else.
say_no_water: There is no water within reach.
say_early: You pull in the empty line.
say_empty: The fish here have gone quiet for now.

ice.note: Ice fishing: where the sheet bears a person (cover 0.5, ice.gd) a cast needs a hole. Right click with an axe or pick cuts one: blows_needed blows at blow_gap_s, a hole stays hole_game_h game hours before it refreezes, at most holes_per_player per player (the oldest goes first), and a cast needs a hole within hole_reach_m. Cold water bites slower: ice_mult on the chance. Holes are kept in memory only.
ice.say_hole: You cut a hole through the ice.
ice.say_no_ice: There is no ice to cut here.
ice.say_need_hole: Cut a hole in the ice first (right click with an axe).

spear.note: Spear fishing (Tyler): a jab with a spear at water within reach_m, standing still (moving under still_below), in water no deeper than max_depth_m when the server can tell. Novices hit about base_chance of the time, better with the Fishing skill, up to max_chance; murky water (rain over rain_over, storm) and noon glare lower it. A strike at water wears the spear one point, a catch uses up one fish of the cell's stock; the spear is never thrown away.
spear.say_move: Stand still a moment, the fish are watching.

net.note: The shore net (list step 9, Dave yes): stand at the water's edge, hold the left button hold_s seconds, then up to catch[1] tries (1 to 3 wanted) each limited by the cell's stock and the fishing chance (dawn and dusk best, hour_mult). reach_m: how far the water point may be; depth_m: wading-depth water only; move_cancel_m: walking further than this cancels. Wear 1 per haul (item durability = uses).
net.say_start: You spread the net in the shallows. Hold still.
net.say_cancel: You pull the net back in.
net.say_no_water: Stand at the water's edge and face the water.
net.say_shallow: The water is too shallow for a net.
net.say_deep: The water is too deep to net from here.
